source_note: Git archive of Prusti HEAD and PCG was taken before concurrent uncommitted stdlib edits; isolated prusti-ferrum Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock were adapted to local Ferrum path dependencies.
build_command: cargo build --locked --offline -p prusti -p prusti-server -p prusti-launch --no-default-features --features prusti/ferrum,prusti-server/ferrum
